seo.OG description: Living in Murrayville, Langley: the Township’s traditional civic core, with the hospital, heritage area, schools and plan rules to check before you buy.

parts.t: Murrayville sits on both sides of the Fraser Highway just east of the City of Langley. The Township calls it its traditional civic core, and it is home to Langley Memorial Hospital, W.C. Blair Recreation Centre and one of only two heritage conservation areas in the Township.

Written by Jared Gibbons, REALTOR®, Royal LePage Little Oak Realty, on October 8, 2026. I have worked in Fraser Valley real estate for 11+ years. Rules and boundaries change, so confirm anything important with the Township of Langley.
Not legal, planning or financial advice. Confirm zoning, plan designations and school catchments before you buy or sell.

parts.t: Murrayville is an established neighbourhood in the Township of Langley, with mature tree-lined streets and a mix of family homes, heritage-style houses and newer developments.
Parks, schools, recreation facilities and local shops are close by, and the neighbourhood is home to Langley Memorial Hospital and the W.C. Blair Recreation Centre.
